note: Returns its input unchanged on domains with no adjacency - point-cloud points and face corners - while the field still type-checks.
Evaluates separately per instance; loose parts and components are hulled together.
Marks sharp edges from Vector handles on the profile only - not Free handles, not the rail, and a poly profile creates no sharp_edge attribute at all.
Both outputs are radians and are displayed as radians, unlike the rotation-unit sockets the editor draws in degrees.
Drops the volume component when two or more volumes are joined - zero grids out, no warning. Every other component type merges.
Silently does nothing on curves and point clouds; only meshes carry the material_index it rewrites.
Picks one component before it picks an index, by a fixed Mesh > Point Cloud > Curve priority that no socket or property shows.
Writing one handle re-derives the opposite one and can change the handle type, so two chained writes do not give two handles.
Works on curves and point clouds, but they carry one material per component and no material_index, so Selection is silently ignored there.
